text:
ellie (marketing): Quick sync — I'm sharing the draft plan for the micro-launch webinar + benchmark post. Need quick takes on claims, routing, and SDR hooks before EOD. Draft doc: https://redwood-internal/drive/micro-launch-draft
jade (research): scanned the draft, nice structure. flag: any top-line % numbers need a short methodology note or we'll get grilled. add one sentence: 'benchmarks run on stable commit X, median latency measured at p50/p95.'
raj (product): Agree with jade. Also add a short bullet about fallback routing to cheaper model variants when Dedicated capacity is maxed — that's a strong differentiator vs managed cloud endpoints.
mike (growth): routing note — make sure every CTA has UTM and a routing tag. Proposed inbound rule (Console -> InboundRouting):
```json
{
  "source": "web",
  "utm_campaign": "micro_launch_q3",
  "interest": "benchmarks",
  "route": "sdr-bench-team",
  "priority": 20
}
```
sara (sales): love the routing. can we also add 2 quick SDR openers and a rebut line for procurement? snippets below:
- "Hey — saw you registered for our bench webinar. curious if you own inference costs or just experimenting with infra?"
- "Quick question: are SLAs or deterministic latency a blocker for adoption today?"
Procurement rebut: "We offer reserved capacity plans + audit logs; most pilots start on Dedicated for predictability."
ellie (marketing): thanks — posting a refined CTA for the registration page. please vote thumbs-up if this copy works: 
"Join our 45-minute micro-launch: real-world benchmarks comparing latency, unit cost, and failover behavior across managed cloud APis and dedicated inference. Actionable tips for predictable cost and rollout."
jade (research): three 3-second soundbites for slides/snack copy:
- "Predictable latency, measurable savings."
- "Same model fidelity, lower unit cost at scale."
- "Graceful degradation beats silent outages."
mike (growth): let's A/B test two hero lines on the landing page: (A) "Latency-first inference for production" vs (B) "Cut inference unit cost without sacrificing quality". Also suggest two email subjects: 
- "Benchmarks: who wins at production latency?"
- "How teams cut token costs — live benchmarks"
sara (sales): add a quick triage field for leads: "primary pain = latency | cost | compliance" so we can route to product-led vs enterprise SDR. Also request a one-liner objection handler for 'we already use cloud provider endpoints': 
"Cloud endpoints are easy to start, but not all workloads scale with predictable latency or cost — we help teams fix that without replatforming the model."
raj (product): add a 2-line bench methodology section in the post so readers can reproduce: include repo link and minimal commands. tiny excerpt for the blog: 
```bash
git clone https://git.internal/redwood/benchmarks.git
cd benchmarks && ./run_bench --model=gptx --sequence=512 --runs=100
```
deploy-bot: Announcement scheduled: webinar landing page goes live 2025-07-15T15:00:00Z; social posts queued for 2025-07-15T16:00:00Z.
ellie (marketing): perfect. final asks: (1) legal quick-check on phrasing 'beats' vs 'vs cloud' (jade can you ping legal?), (2) approvals for copy by 17:00 PT, (3) can sales confirm the SDR snippets above are ready to import into Outreach? @sara
sara (sales): will confirm by 16:30 PT, will also upload the triage dropdown to the lead intake form.
jade (research): pinged legal in DM, noted the methodology blurbs are safe.
ellie (marketing): thanks team — if no objections I’ll push the landing copy at 15:00 and route leads to sdr-bench-team. :thumbsup:
